superseded.confidence_note: Allowance, rates, plan shapes and the card-verification sentence are on the pricing page read today. The documentation elsewhere says all users must add a payment method; that contradiction is unresolved and a signup would settle it.
superseded.notes: This is the strongest free tier in the lane for an always-on small service: no card, no sleeping, USD 20 a month. It is not a USD 100 credit and it does not buy a month of a big machine: at USD 0.13 an hour for 4 vCPU / 8 GB the allowance is 153.8 hours, and at USD 0.016438 an hour for 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB it is 1,216 hours, so a full month fits only at the smallest shape with USD 8 left over.
